identity.name: GMT-Master II
identity.one_liner: The 2007-2019 GMT-Master II that introduced the Cerachrom bezel to the line, with a green 24-hour hand.

narrative.story: The 116710LN restarted the GMT-Master II in 2007 with a single-color black ceramic bezel, a wider maxi case, and a green 24-hour hand as the only color on an otherwise monochrome watch. It ran twelve years as the accessible GMT while the two-color bezels drew the waitlists. Since discontinuation it has become the value entry into the ceramic GMT era.
narrative.collector_notes: Long production means plenty of supply — buy on condition. Check the green hand's lume match against the dial and the bezel edge for wear.
